## Blueprint.dropColumn() method

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Queue columns for removal.

**Signature:**

```typescript
dropColumn(...names: string[]): this;
```

This blueprint, for chaining.

## Remarks

Only meaningful on an `alter` blueprint. One `ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN` is emitted per name; older sqlite builds reject the statement outright, and no dialect will restore the data, so this is not reversible.
